configs.title: Branch-length optimization with divergence-based rerooting (flu/h3n2/20).
configs.content:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neherlab/treetime/rust/packages/schemas/input-config-optimize.schema.json

# Branch-length optimization with divergence-based rerooting (flu/h3n2/20).
#
# Run from any folder; relative paths in this file resolve from its folder, and
# `--output-all` chooses the output folder. From the repository root:
#   treetime optimize --config data/flu/h3n2/20/optimize-reroot-min-dev.yaml --output-all tmp/examples/flu/h3n2/20/optimize-reroot-min-dev
#
# `optimize` re-estimates every branch length under the substitution model and
# (here) reroots to minimize root-to-tip divergence variance. This is the
# date-free step that replaces `augur refine` in a Nextstrain build.

tree: "tree.nwk"
alignment:
  - "aln.fasta.xz"

# Per-edge optimizer: Brent's method in sqrt(t) space (the default, matches v0).
optimizer: "brent"

# Reroot by minimizing root-to-tip divergence variance (a date-free method).
reroot: "min-dev"

configs.title: Time-scaled tree with a fixed clock rate and date confidence intervals (flu/h3n2/200).
configs.content:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neherlab/treetime/rust/packages/schemas/input-config-timetree.schema.json

# Time-scaled tree with a fixed clock rate and date confidence intervals (flu/h3n2/200).
#
# Run from any folder; relative paths in this file resolve from its folder, and
# `--output-all` chooses the output folder. From the repository root:
#   treetime timetree --config data/flu/h3n2/200/timetree-fixed-clock.yaml --output-all tmp/examples/flu/h3n2/200/timetree-fixed-clock
#
# `timetree` turns divergence into calendar time. Fixing the clock rate (`clock_rate`)
# skips rate estimation and is common for well-characterized pathogens like seasonal
# influenza. `confidence` adds date confidence intervals, which need a rate
# uncertainty (`clock_std_dev`) when the rate is fixed; `coalescent: opt` fits a
# constant coalescent time scale analytically. The rate and its uncertainty are those
# of the Nextstrain h3n2 NA builds.

tree: "tree.nwk"
metadata: "metadata.tsv"
alignment:
  - "aln.fasta.xz"

clock_rate: 0.00267
clock_std_dev: 0.000534
confidence: true
coalescent: "opt"
max_iter: 3

# A fixed seed makes the random steps of the run, such as polytomy resolution, repeat
# exactly.
seed: 42

# The default outputs: with `confidence`, the node dates table holds the 90%
# intervals.
output_selection:
  - "nwk"
  - "nexus"
  - "auspice"
  - "node-data"
  - "model"
  - "sequences"
  - "clock-model"
  - "coalescent"
  - "dates"
